newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-New South Wales Treasury Secretary resigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-New South Wales Treasury Secretary resigns.

text.p: The Secretary of the New South Wales Treasury has resigned to take up a postion in the prviate sector, the New South Wales Government said on Wednesday.
Michael Lambert will leave his postion as head of the Treasury to join investment bank BZW, NSW Treasurer Michael Egan said in a statement.
Egan said Lambert had worked for both Labour and Coalition governments with complete impartiality and professionalism.

"He has a well deserved reputation as one of the nation's most distinguished public servants, and under his stewardship the NSW Treasury has maintained its position in the first rank of government agencies," Egan said.
